notes.title: PATCH UPDATE v0.3.10 🌰
notes.content:
[h1]It’s Raining Acorn – Patch Update v0.3.10 🌰[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445842/53a4d3099d8f6fe9ba511c3a6f07291bf4d9cba7.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! We’ve got a fresh update for[b] It’s Raining Acorn![/b] This patch brings several fixes and a bit of rebalancing to keep things fair (sorry, OP Axolotl & Salamander gang 😢). Check out what’s new:

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed description text errors[/b] – No more mysterious typos haunting your screens!
[*] [b]UI display bugfix[/b] – Icons should now show up properly instead of pulling a disappearing act.
[*]  [b]Cooldown timer fix[/b] – Cooldowns should now behave correctly instead of randomly deciding to take a break.
[*] [b]Axolotl & Salamander rebalance[/b] – Increased cooldown to keep them from being too overpowered (we know, it was fun while it lasted).
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and as always, let us know what you think! 🐿

notes.title: PATCH UPDATE v0.3.8 🌰
notes.content:
[h1]It’s Raining Acorn – Patch Update 🌰[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445842/5ee1a72f9dd7e923d7d0dbc360ce7feb0a798310.jpg[/img]

We’ve squashed some bugs and made improvements to keep your acorn-bouncing experience as smooth as possible! 🌰 Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where triggers sometimes couldn’t be placed even when the slot looked empty.
[*] Fixed an issue where point was deducted during merging (leveling up), but the merge didn’t happen.
[*] Fixed certain triggers that didn’t spawn carcasses when removed.
[*] Rebalanced some triggers to unlock earlier in the game.
[*] Adjusted trigger rarity for better progression.
[*] Rebalanced rarity calculation to make higher rarities easier to obtain.
[*] Reworked several triggers, especially insect-related ones, to make their meta more fun and manageable.
[/list]

Enjoy the updated gameplay and happy acorn-bouncing! 🌟

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.2
notes.content:
Hi Squirrel 🐿️.

Have fun!
